meals.name: Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Boiled Eggs on Sourdough with Avocado
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of a tall glass of purple kefir blueberry smoothie beside two sliced boiled eggs on toasted whole-grain sourdough spread with avocado, natural morning light on a white marble counter
prep_steps: Hard-boil 14 eggs on Sunday (7 days × 2 people, alternating with other breakfasts — boil 10 for Mon–Fri use): place eggs in cold water, bring to boil, cook 10 min, transfer to ice bath, peel, store in airtight container in fridge.
day_of_steps: 1. Pour 250 ml plain kefir into a blender.
2. Add 80 g blueberries (Diego) / 60 g blueberries (Diana) and half a banana each.
3. Blend 30 seconds until smooth; pour into a glass.
4. Toast 40 g sourdough (Diego) / 30 g sourdough (Diana) in the toaster.
5. Halve 2 boiled eggs (Diego) / 2 boiled eggs (Diana) from the batch and place on toast.

6. Spread ¼ avocado (mashed, from a fresh avocado bought this week — if not on locked list, substitute 2 tsp olive oil drizzled on toast) — NOTE: avocado is NOT in the locked palette; use 2 tsp olive oil + a pinch of salt instead.
7. Drizzle 1 tsp olive oil over eggs, season with black pepper and salt. Serve with 500 ml water.

5. In same pan, add 1 tsp sesame oil, 100 g broccoli florets + 80 g sliced carrots (per person — same veg, same pan, plate separately). Stir-fry 4–5 min over high heat. Add remaining marinade, toss 1 min.
6. Plate: rice → stir-fried veg → salmon fillet on top. Serve with 500 ml water.
